description.value: Triple O's is a BC-born quick-service burger chain celebrated for its signature Triple "O" sauce, hand-scooped milkshakes, and fresh-cut Kennebec fries. This Sardis/Chilliwack location is co-located inside a Chevron gas station on Vedder Road and offers drive-thru, dine-in, and takeout options including breakfast. It sits on a main arterial route through the Fraser Valley, making it a convenient calorie stop for touring cyclists moving through the Chilliwack area.
